note: The same transaction is prepared for every row; only the provider-policy read changes. The guard, the boundary and combine_provider_policy are the real product code.

provider.layer: near provider policy (NEAR Intents Agent API)

results.description: the provider policy is applied, synced and enables native.near.transfer
results.detail: the provider policy (revision 5) is applied and synced, not frozen, and enables native.near.transfer

results.description: a policy update that is not APPLIED / not provider-synced is never active
results.detail: the provider policy is not in force (status=REQUESTED, provider_policy_synced=False); a requested or signed update is not active, so no operation is authorized under it

results.description: the provider froze the agent's wallet (explicit denial)
results.detail: the provider has frozen this agent's wallet; no operation is permitted

results.description: the policy does not enable native.near.transfer (explicit denial)
results.detail: the provider policy does not enable native.near.transfer; a native NEAR transfer is refused by this policy

results.description: the provider returned a policy for a different agent (the gate's own AGENT_MISMATCH)
results.detail: the provider returned a policy for agent 'some-other-agent', not 'treasury-agent'; refusing to treat it as this agent's policy

results.description: the provider refused the read (401) - LIVE Agent API with the injected key
results.detail: provider policy could not be established (UNAUTHENTICATED): the provider refused the request (missing or wrong credentials)

results.description: no policy exists for this agent (404)
results.detail: provider policy could not be established (NOT_FOUND): no policy exists for this agent yet

results.description: the provider returned a body that cannot be interpreted
results.detail: provider policy could not be established (MALFORMED): the provider policy could not be interpreted: policy must be a JSON object

results.description: the policy read raised a transport error
results.detail: provider policy could not be established (UNAVAILABLE): policy read failed: TimeoutError

results.description: no Agent API base URL is configured
results.detail: provider policy could not be established (UNCONFIGURED): No Agent API base URL is configured. Set TRACESETTLE_NEAR_AGENT_API_URL and TRACESETTLE_NEAR_AGENT_API_KEY to read live policy, or load a local fixture with PolicyAdapter.from_fixture.

results.description: the adapter reports a stale revision (the gate's own STALE vocabulary)
results.detail: provider policy could not be established (STALE): the policy revision is older than the configured maximum age

results.description: the layer is required but no adapter is configured; must refuse outright
results.detail: the independent NEAR provider policy is required but no policy adapter or agent id is configured; refusing to authorize without the second policy layer
